update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.21 - App performance optimizations
Performance --- - Lazy-load settings sub-pages and Chat to reduce cold-start bundle work - Deferred first paint on heavy settings screens (Settings misc, Chat, etc.) - Memoized parent-farming bundle grid cards and narrower context subscriptions - Chat recent questions use FlashList; Skills plan list uses FlashList via CustomScrollView - Search registry skips runtime registration for statically indexed settings ids
CI / quality --- - ESLint in CI (0 errors), perf-nav validation workflow, Gradle cache on CI - Typecheck fixes for solver preview cache import and parent-farming resolver
Includes v5.9.20 dark mode toggle fix and v5.9.19 settings UI overhaul.
